Usage: changji [options]

  --init-config         write a commented config template and exit
  --force               with --init-config: overwrite an existing config
  --help                show this text
  --version             print the version and exit

  --worker              start in worker mode: compute only, no API
  --gpu <n>             which card to bind, default 0

  Upscale a video and exit (this is what the checkup means by “render the

  --upscale <in> <out>  the video to upscale, and where to write it
  --upscale-model <file>

                        catalog; download it yourself
  --upscale-size <WxH>  target size, like 1440x2560
                        All three have to be given; leave one out and it says
                        which one is missing

  Speak one line with the in-process voice and exit (no server, no project):
  --say <text>          the line to speak
  --out <file>          where to write it, default say.wav
  --voice <audio>       reference voice: a clip of someone speaking
                        (wav/mp3/flac). Without it, the model’s own voice
  --tts-model <file>    use this backbone just this once, over [models].tts
  --tts-decoder <file>  use this decoder just this once, over [models].tts_decoder
